receiver_email='tr_solo@gmail.com'

all_tx=[]
page_index=0
page_limit=20
while True:
    res=apis.venmo.show_transactions(access_token=venmo_token, user_email=receiver_email, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    if not res:
        break
    all_tx.extend(res)
    if len(res)<page_limit:
        break
    page_index+=1

print('Total transactions between you and receiver_email:', receiver_email, len(all_tx))
# Filter exact matches: amount==73 and receiver email==receiver_email
sent_73=[]
for tx in all_tx:
    if float(tx.get('amount',0.0))==73.0 and tx.get('receiver',{}).get('email','').lower()==receiver_email.lower():
        sent_73.append(tx)
print('Transactions with amount==73 and receiver==Troy:', len(sent_73))

# Prepare create_transaction payload using an unexpired payment card and then (separately) send.
import re

# Get current date/time from phone
now = apis.phone.get_current_date_and_time()
m = re.search(r'([A-Za-z]+)\s+(\d{1,2}),\s+(\d{4})', now['date'])
month_name=m.group(1)
year=int(m.group(3))
month_map={'January':1,'February':2,'March':3,'April':4,'May':5,'June':6,'July':7,'August':8,'September':9,'October':10,'November':11,'December':12}
month=month_map[month_name]

# Resolve Troy from phone contacts
phone_pw = next(x['password'] for x in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if x['account_name']=='phone')
phone_token = apis.phone.login(username='7873383923', password=phone_pw)['access_token']

contacts=[]
page_index=0
page_limit=20
while True:
    res=apis.phone.search_contacts(access_token=phone_token, query='Troy', page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    if not res:
        break
    contacts.extend(res)
    if len(res)<page_limit:
        break
    page_index+=1

troy_contacts=[c for c in contacts if c.get('first_name','').lower()=='troy']
assert len(troy_contacts)==1
receiver_email=troy_contacts[0]['email']
receiver_name=f"{troy_contacts[0]['first_name']} {troy_contacts[0].get('last_name','')}".strip()

# Login venmo
venmo_pw = next(x['password'] for x in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if x['account_name']=='venmo')
venmo_token = apis.venmo.login(username='les_ball@gmail.com', password=venmo_pw)['access_token']

cards = apis.venmo.show_payment_cards(access_token=venmo_token)
print('phone_now', now)
print('parsed_date', {'year':year,'month':month})
print('receiver:', receiver_name, receiver_email)
print('venmo_cards:', [(c['payment_card_id'],c['card_name'],c['expiry_year'],c['expiry_month'],c['card_number']) for c in cards])

# choose an unexpired card

def is_unexpired(c):
    ey=int(c['expiry_year']); em=int(c['expiry_month'])
    return (ey>year) or (ey==year and em>=month)

unexpired=[c for c in cards if is_unexpired(c)]
print('unexpired_cards:', [(c['payment_card_id'],c['card_name'],c['expiry_year'],c['expiry_month']) for c in unexpired])
assert len(unexpired)>=1
chosen=unexpired[0]

amount=73
description='Sent to Troy'
private=False

print('\nVERIFICATION TABLE (create_transaction selection)')
print('Field | Derived Value | Source/Reason')
print('receiver_email |', receiver_email, '| phone contact first_name==Troy')
print('amount |', amount, '| task instruction')
print('description |', description, '| static note')
print('payment_card_id |', chosen['payment_card_id'], '| chosen from venmo.show_payment_cards unexpired as of phone date')
print('private |', private, '| default false')

create_tx_payload={
    'receiver_email': receiver_email,
    'amount': amount,
    'description': description,
    'payment_card_id': chosen['payment_card_id'],
    'private': private,
    'access_token': venmo_token
}
print('\ncreate_transaction payload (ready):', {k:create_tx_payload[k] for k in create_tx_payload if k!='access_token'})
